name: COLONEL FANSHAWE
whenNote: Errata 68 D: on the funeral day the office is drawn without him; he is up the hill. He never leaves his office except for funerals (doc 57).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the carpet before the desk's left end, clear of his welcoming hand (errata 84 C).
note: COLONEL ABSALOM FANSHAWE, President of the Consolation Improvement Company, at his desk (doc 04: 'warm, generous, expansive, unfailingly courteous'). Canon gives him no appearance but his portrait's ('painted at approximately twice life size and one-third his actual age'), so he is a portly, prosperous gentleman of about sixty with the portrait's moustache -- silver hair and whiskers, a black frock coat, a brocade waistcoat, a gold watch chain (errata 84 B). Drawn first in room-11's composition master beside Thad (style gate step 1), then alone on magenta in five poses (room-11 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room11-fanshawe.py. BEHIND THE DESK: the sheet stops at the desk top's back edge, so `y` is the cut row, not his feet. REDRAWN AT THAD'S PIXEL SIZE (Tyler, 2026-11-02: 'Thad is pixelated, not smooth'; 'Bigger pixels'): the five poses regenerated against a side-by-side of Thad beside him (errata 84 J).
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Fanshawe.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest (hands on his waistcoat) · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 welcome, his hand open · 3 the watch · 4 laughing. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool (errata 35 and 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s). He welcomes as he talks.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from his crop of the locked cast master by cast-unify operation 14 (reference/cast-unify-12.txt), with nothing on the desk or counter; the sheet has no clean grid, so it is cut with its own pixels and only the edge cleaned (tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py --grid 1), registered on the head, sized so his head (crown to shoulders) matches the drawing it replaces; face width put him 21% too large. Same poses.
sprite.waistOnNote: The plate row the figure's waist ends on: his desk's back edge (y 495 at x 1031); nothing on the desk is his and his hands never come below it. Held by tests/counter-surface.test.mjs against the plate.
